data.content_ref: inline:Minimal-core extraction: conjecture that the suspension boundary (SRC_002) is epiphenomenal, not constitutive — an artifact of the Pass 1 algorithm's tie-break, not a semantic primitive. If so, strip it: define the semantics purely by which nodes are IN (accepted) and OUT (refuted), with UNDECIDED as a derived, non-first-class state. The stripped semantics keeps all four guarantees, has fewer concepts, and forces any genuine extension to justify itself against the smaller core. This is the contraction opposite to the neighbourhood's expansionist direction; it predicts every proposed extension (SRC_004, SRC_006, SRC_007) can be re-expressed, and re-criticized, in the stripped language.
